title: Bounded-origin properties of the strict proper/open comparison

source.place: Lemmas 4.10, 5.16 and 5.22: prove bounded-origin invertibility, bounds, and the evaluation mate equation for supplied P and R.

proof.text: Construct an exact single-level section of etale coefficient evaluation by putting the module at its chosen index and zero elsewhere. Its derived functor preserves the lower bound and realizes the chosen finite object. Use it to deduce finite open bounds and finite right-adjoint bounds from the given system coherence and uniform bound, and to deduce the finite site counit on origin objects from the given system site equivalence.

Apply the proper-only finite mate theorem after finite open extension. Its composite with the supplied open comparison gives invertibility of the finite support comparison. For a finite origin witness transport the etale support object along this comparison; exact inverse image and the proper direct-image lower bound give the resulting finite origin.

Identify the vertical evaluation mates with the supplied direct-image evaluation isomorphisms by their counit equations. Apply the exchange-mate cube to the proper square and use the supplied open evaluation square and naturality. This proves the asserted equality of actual morphisms. Detect system comparison invertibility by evaluations; transport finite origin witnesses through support evaluation. For the finite origin comparison compose the finite comparison with the now invertible site counit.

proof_origin.place: Zheng Construction 5.15 and Lemmas 4.10, 5.16, 5.22; formal single-level lifting, adjunction bounds and mate-cube assembly by F8.
